quizName: DMV Practice Test #16 25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: What does an integrated braking system do?

options.text: It connects the front and rear brakes so they work together when you use the rear brake.
It brakes automatically by learning your riding style.
It is connected to the gears and applies the brake when you shift down.

questions.correctAnswerText: It connects the front and rear brakes so they work together when you use the rear brake.
questions.explanation: Some motorcycles have integrated braking systems. When you apply the rear brake pedal, it activates both the front and rear brakes together. Check your owner's manual to learn about your motorcycle's braking system.

questions.question: When crossing angled railroad tracks, it is usually best to:

options.text: Use the road shoulder to slow down before crossing.
Walk your motorcycle across the tracks.
Ride straight across the tracks staying in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride straight across the tracks staying in your lane.
questions.explanation: The safest way is to ride straight across angled railroad or trolley tracks. If you change your angle to cross the tracks, you may move into another lane and hit oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Eye protection is:
questions.explanation: Georgia law requires all motorcycle riders to wear eye protection while riding. A full face shield gives you the best protection.

questions.question: If you carry a load on your motorcycle, it should be:
questions.explanation: Loads should be secured as low as possible, unless you use saddlebags. Attaching a load to a sissy bar raises your motorcycle's center of gravity and makes it harder to balance.

questions.question: Riders who are above the legal drinking age with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of ______ or higher are considered legally intoxicated.
questions.explanation: In South Dakota, it is illegal to operate a motorcycle if your blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is 0.08 percent or higher. You can also be charged with impaired driving with a lower BAC.

questions.question: How can you tell if a helmet is DOT-certified?

options.text: It will have a label attached to the helmet with the certification information.
DOT-certified helmets are the only helmets sold in North America.
It will have a green dot inside the helmet.

questions.correctAnswerText: It will have a label attached to the helmet with the certification information.
questions.explanation: A Department of Transportation (DOT) certified helmet will have a label attached showing the manufacturer's name and the helmet model.

questions.question: Under normal conditions, you should stay ______ behind the vehicle ahead of you.
questions.explanation: New motorcycle riders should keep at least four seconds of distance behind the vehicle ahead during good conditions. Increase this distance if conditions are poor.

questions.question: If you reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time as another vehicle:

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
Flash your headlight to tell the other vehicle to go ahead.
Continue through and expect the other vehicle to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection with no signs or traffic lights, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right.

questions.question: When riding at night, you should:

options.text: Ride close to the vehicle ahead so you can use its lights to see better.
Keep your normal speed to avoid being hit from behind.
Slow down and increase your distance from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and increase your distance from other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed and increase your following distance when riding at night. You cannot see as well in the dark, so you need more time and space to react to dangers.

questions.question: A motorcycle's horn is ______ a passenger car's horn.
questions.explanation: Motorcycle horns are not as loud as car horns. You can use your horn when needed, but do not rely on it to keep you safe.

questions.question: Where is there the greatest chance of a conflict between a motorcycle and other traffic?
questions.explanation: Intersections have the most conflicts between motorcycles and other vehicles. Motorcycle riders must be very careful at intersections.

questions.question: Helmets are:

options.text: Only required for new motorcycle riders.

questions.explanation: Georgia law requires all riders to wear a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation standards. A helmet is the best protection against head and neck injuries if there is an accident.

questions.question: When should you keep more space between your motorcycle and the vehicle in front?

options.text: If you can see through the vehicles in front to check traffic ahead.

questions.explanation: You need more space if it takes longer to stop. Keep at least a four-second gap if the pavement is slippery, if you cannot see ahead clearly, or if traffic is heavy.

questions.question: On a motorcycle, which brake is more powerful?

options.text: Both brakes have equal stopping power.
The front brake is more powerful.
The rear brake is more powerful.

questions.correctAnswerText: The front brake is more powerful.
questions.explanation: The front brake is stronger than the rear brake. It provides about 70 percent of the motorcycle's total stopping power.

questions.question: What formation should a group of motorcycles use?
questions.explanation: A staggered formation is best for group riding. Switch to single-file when turning, curving, entering or leaving a highway.

questions.question: Which is NOT a reason to keep space between your motorcycle and the vehicle ahead?

options.text: It gives you more time to react to dangers.
It prevents you from finding an escape route.
It gives you room to move your motorcycle safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: It prevents you from finding an escape route.
questions.explanation: Space between vehicles gives you time to react if a driver makes a mistake. This space also lets you safely move your motorcycle when needed.

questions.question: At what blood alcohol level can riders under 21 be arrested?
questions.explanation: Riders under 21 can be arrested if their blood alcohol level is 0.02 percent or higher. It is never safe to ride a motorcycle after drinking.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is white with red and black markings. It tells drivers the traffic rules for that area. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Before you ride, the fuel valve should be:
questions.explanation: Always open the fuel valve before riding. If it is closed, the engine may start but will stall once the fuel in the lines runs out.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop completely and go when it is safe.
Slow down and yield to other traffic.
Other vehicles will enter the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all cross traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: When traffic is present, where should you position your motorcycle when entering a curve?
questions.explanation: When traffic is present, stay in the center of your lane through the curve. Without traffic, riders can start on the outside, move to the inside, and exit on the outside. Always watch for changing road and traffic conditions and adjust as needed.

questions.question: Before starting a turn, a motorcyclist should change gears to:

options.text: Prevent a sudden change in power in the middle of the turn
Keep both hands on the handle grips during the turn
Keep the motorcycle from slowing down

questions.correctAnswerText: Prevent a sudden change in power in the middle of the turn
questions.explanation: Change gears before you start turning. Shifting while turning can cause sudden power changes that make the rear wheel skid. If you must shift during a turn, do it smoothly to help prevent skidding.

questions.question: If a dog is chasing you, you should:

options.text: Stop your motorcycle until the dog loses interest
Slow down as the dog approaches, then quickly speed up and ride away

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down as the dog approaches, then quickly speed up and ride away
questions.explanation: When you see a dog approaching, slow down and shift to a lower gear. As the dog gets close, quickly speed up and ride away.

questions.question: Shifting gears up or down in a curve:

options.text: Should only be done if it can be done smoothly
Is better than shifting before the curve
Is the best way to control your speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Should only be done if it can be done smoothly
questions.explanation: It is best to change gears before turning. If you must shift while turning, shift smoothly. A sudden change in power can cause the rear wheel to skid.
